name: Benedict Hardie
bio: Benedict Hardie is an Australian film actor and writer. He is best known for his roles in Hacksaw Ridge (2016), The Light Between Oceans (2016), Upgrade (2018), The Invisible Man (2020) and Wolf Man (2025).

The show is a hit due to Judy's superior puppeteering but Punch's driving ambition and penchant for whisky lead to an inevitable tragedy that Judy must avenge.

credits.overview: A rock star general bent on winning the “impossible” war in Afghanistan takes us inside the complex machinery of modern war. Inspired by the true story of General Stanley McChrystal.

credits.title: The Light Between Oceans
credits.overview: A lighthouse keeper and his wife living off the coast of Western Australia raise a baby they rescue from an adrift rowboat.

credits.overview: The story of how, from the early 1970s, Australia's eccentric Ian 'Molly' Meldrum became a loved and respected rock music guru as host of the TV show Countdown.

credits.title: Strangerland
credits.overview: Newly arrived to a remote desert town, Catherine and Matthew are tormented by a suspicion when their two teenage children mysteriously vanish.
